conventions.statistic: fold = the paper's max over all hidden states of |max(AUROC, 1-AUROC) - 0.5|; signed = mean over relative depth 0.25-0.75 of (AUROC - 0.5); per-wrapper Pearson r with log10 parameters
conventions.note: full-task directions of the paper; hidden state 0 counts in the depth
conventions.pooling: validated (Qwen2.5: lf scoring, all-token directions, as pod_ladders)
conventions.layers: ALL for fold; relative depth 0.25-0.75 for signed
